purpose: Machine-readable geometric/aesthetic failure modes observed in live builds. ADVISORY ONLY: surfaced in the packet CREATIVE_CONTEXT to steer composition; never overrides precedence, never appears in MANDATORY_PLACEMENT_CONTEXT, never fails the gate. Distinct from data/NEGATIVE_KNOWLEDGE_INDEX.json (which is mechanical, gate-routed tier 6).

APEX_SWIRL_INTERLEAVED_CONVERGENCE.trigger_params: 16-facet rings built as 8 main + 8 interleaved corner facets (offset azimuth, radius x1.05) carried to a small apex radius
APEX_SWIRL_INTERLEAVED_CONVERGENCE.symptom: facets collide at the tiny top radius and pinwheel into a swirl
APEX_SWIRL_INTERLEAVED_CONVERGENCE.fix: stop facets before convergence; apply SOLID_FINIAL_CAP (truncate at a usable radius, plug with a single un-stacked cap)

OUTWARD_BULGE_SPIKINESS.trigger_params: positive (outward) tilt and/or the x1.05 radial outset on interleaved corner facets
OUTWARD_BULGE_SPIKINESS.fix: keep tilt inward (negative phi); drop the radial outset for clean surfaces

FAN_VAULT_MISUSE_AS_POINT.symptom: stacked-and-rotated reads as a fan/pinwheel; a single one reads as an octagonal star-plate
FAN_VAULT_MISUSE_AS_POINT.fix: do NOT use as a clean point/finial; it is a fan/star VAULT piece. Use a CORNERPOST spike or a converging-rib tip for a point

ROOF_TILE_SHINGLING_NONSMOOTH.symptom: profiled roof tile shingles into overlapping scales; cannot form a smooth continuous surface (worsened by an RZ180 spin)
ROOF_TILE_SHINGLING_NONSMOOTH.fix: for a smooth glass surface use a FLAT glass panel (e.g. PANEL_GLASS) or plain vertical facets; accept scales only when texture is the goal

PART_WIDTH_EXCEEDS_BASE.trigger_params: facet width > base circumference / facet count (e.g. a 5.84-wide diagonal on an N=4 small base)
PART_WIDTH_EXCEEDS_BASE.fix: match part width to base circumference; N=8 octagon is the reliable minimum for the standard _M walls

TIER_GAP_RING_SPACING.symptom: horizontal gaps appear between stacked rings
TIER_GAP_RING_SPACING.fix: ring z-spacing must be <= the facet's vertical extent for a connected surface

COMPOUND_CONE_COLLAR_COLLAPSE.symptom: the upper stage starts near-zero radius and collapses; finial floats
COMPOUND_CONE_COLLAR_COLLAPSE.fix: truncate the lower cone stage at a WIDER radius before the collar
